scope: bounded deterministic dependency/retry/approval/kill-switch/compensation workflow; no external action runner or actual tool-side rollback claim; executed via real loopback HTTP, caller-owned embedded instance and two-worker replicated transport; no public deployment/microcontroller/multi-host claim

independentGeneration.requestedToolPolicy: read only named frozen candidates; no other filesystem, memory, network, tools or writes

runtimeControls: observed peer death and replacement replay
authorityProfile: local source/binary-bound target execution, frozen cases and fresh exact independent proposals; no new hosted CI

trials.intent: A task dependency names a previously completed task index; reject a dependency at or beyond the number of completed tasks.
Success requires one additional attempt after all planned failures; reject when failures consume the entire attempt budget.
Stop a workflow before an approval-required task if human approval is absent; approved tasks may proceed if dependencies and retries permit.
